policy.skillLogic: V1.9-style causal, direct exposure, earnings conversion, expectation, timing and adversarial discipline; no frequency quota and no relaxed Primary gate.
policy.weeklyCheckpoint: Friday after market close; next executable session is entry.
policy.outcome: 60 trading-day net return and excess versus CSI300.
policy.caveat: Historical replay built in 2026; exact early-entry outcomes were not fetched until after this decision file is frozen, but model/search historical memory remains a contamination risk.

eventDecisions.reason: Industry and company earnings acceleration were real, but both direct optical names were in an adverse 20d/60d relative regime at the first post-event weekly checkpoint; unchanged V1.9 timing gate blocks a fresh entry.

eventDecisions.name: 紫金矿业
eventDecisions.reason: Record gold plus realized company growth is a direct bridge, but the gold basket already had strong 20d/60d absorption; continuation/high absorption blocks Primary.

eventDecisions.name: 兆易创新
eventDecisions.reason: Fresh EOL/tightening evidence plus Q1 positive profit conversion and a favorable but not extreme broad memory regime support Research; cash-flow/expectation burden prevents Primary.

eventDecisions.name: 阳光电源
eventDecisions.reason: Sungrow Q1 profit and cash conversion were strong and directly differentiated from loss-making module capacity; broad solar timing was adverse, so only a company-engine Research exception is allowed.

eventDecisions.name: 北方稀土
eventDecisions.reason: Fresh export bottleneck plus realized Q1 volume/profit/cash acceleration and only moderate prior price absorption create the cleanest fresh-incremental company bridge in H1.

eventDecisions.name: 顺络电子
eventDecisions.reason: Fresh AI/consumer divergence plus same-week H1 profit/cash and data-center order growth provide direct company conversion; neutral sector timing and limited expectation-gap proof keep it Research.

eventDecisions.name: 许继电气
eventDecisions.reason: The global order cycle plus H1 contract-liability/cash evidence create a company exception, but revenue/profit growth remained weak and the basket was only neutral; Research rather than Primary.

eventDecisions.name: 兆易创新
eventDecisions.reason: H1 company evidence confirms the cycle, but high valuation and strong 20d price absorption mean the continuation is Research only.

Siyuan had strong general grid earnings and potential data-center spillover, but direct AIDC company exposure was not yet proven while the two-name basket had already gained roughly 46% excess over 60d; high absorption plus mapping ambiguity blocks selection.
